high_level_description: A single small terrier in a low digging pose, wearing a visible brown leather harness, centered low on a 1600x900 canvas with grass foreground and pale sky background.

compositional_deconstruction.background: Pale blue sky occupying upper 85% of canvas; green grass band occupying lower 15%.

elements.desc: Terrier torso: light tan oval, centered horizontally, low vertical position
Terrier head: smaller light tan oval, above and slightly forward of torso
Front left leg: vertical dark brown rectangle, attached to lower-left torso
Front right leg: vertical dark brown rectangle, attached to lower-right torso
Rear left leg: vertical dark brown rectangle, angled slightly back, lower than front legs
Rear right leg: vertical dark brown rectangle, angled slightly back, lower than front legs
Chest harness strap: horizontal brown rectangle across upper torso
Belly harness strap: horizontal brown rectangle across mid-torso, below chest strap
Back harness strap: vertical brown rectangle connecting chest and belly straps at center-back
Left ear: small dark brown triangle, attached to left side of head
Right ear: small dark brown triangle, attached to right side of head
Tail: thin brown ellipse, curving upward from rear of torso
Grass band: horizontal strip of overlapping green tuft shapes across full width, bottom-aligned
